telephony_twilio_to_india_mobile.source: twilio.com/en-us/voice/pricing/in: India - Mobile $0.0496/min; Twilio IN guideline: outbound to India only from non-Indian numbers (data/teardown/vapi/pricing/twilio_voice_pricing_in.html)

compare_2026_10_17_ECO17: ECO-17: INR 11.6-17.5 at FX 88 (Vapi + Twilio). Same platform fee; at FX 95 with the India-mobile rate the range is the one above.

vapi_side_cogs_reconstruction.pass_through: STT/LLM/TTS billed "at cost / no markup" (vendor-claimed on pricing page); telephony billed by the customer's own carrier (Twilio/Telnyx/Vonage/SIP), so 0 margin to Vapi on those lines unless platform-key volume discounts exist (unknown).
hosting_cost_drivers: Daily WebRTC + Twilio/Cloudflare TURN for web calls
Neon + Aurora DBs, Redis cache, Kafka/ClickHouse logs (job posts)
vapi_side_cogs_reconstruction.basis: compute at roughly 0.25-1 vCPU per concurrent call at USD 0.03-0.05 per vCPU-hour = USD 0.0001-0.0008/min, plus media relay, storage, logging and fixed platform cost spread over volume; not measured. An HN user (item 46189900) reported the platform fee was 60-70% of their total spend.

price_floor_note: Even at zero AI cost, an Indian outbound minute on Vapi costs the buyer about INR 9.46 (hosting 4.75 + Twilio India mobile 4.71) before any model, against Indian all-in list prices of INR 3.5-7/min (rejected.2026-10-17.parity-undercut) and VP's INR 2-3.5/min target tiers.
